# Player Took Damage

Source: [wiki article 4819](../archive/4819.md); edited 2024-11-26.

<a id="wiki-4819-n1"></a>

- Took Damage includes self-damage and checks rule conditions on event; Event Player equals Victim, Attacker is source (equal for self-damage).

<a id="wiki-4819-n2"></a>

- Context supplies received damage, critical-hit flag, ability and incoming direction.
